shortcut_findings: Meeting order, latest date, last record, title and Source ID stay fixed while the required answer changes. None resolves the destination. A rule that always chooses the first or second trust fails both the switch and the unresolved control.

SD-Q7M2 is a shared-stock label, useful for matching instrument to entry but not a trust code or sequence. Similar parent references are not interchangeable; wildcard compatibility is not identity. Shared trustees, deed date, custody service and overlapping object lists do not license unioning the trusts or the hypothetical files.

Signing is not delivery; recording delivery is not making a designation; eligibility is not an award. There is no competing draft here. Similar names such as Della Pennick and Orla Penrick establish neither identity nor kinship.
limitations: The recorded isolated tests establish the specified critical outcomes, not universal reader reliability, byte-perfect reader citations, or all suggested whole-document ablations. The comparison tests exact reference resolution in this packet, not general alias handling, resistance to order permutations, date shifts or draft substitution. A reader exposed to case labels or keys could memorise the changed digit; those labels are not evidence.
The extracts omit schedules, the live register extract covers one entry, and the preparation set is closed. No identified distribution authority is not proof that none exists elsewhere.
